controller_6m.notes: exists=false confirmed. This is a Chapter 18C specialist technology issuer with no Listing-Rules Controlling Shareholder lock-up split: Rule 18C.14(1) imposes a single 12-month no-disposal undertaking on the Key Persons (p.267), and Rule 18C.14(2) a 6-month undertaking on Pathfinder SIIs (p.267-268), who are not controllers. No separate controller 6-month slot exists.
